Global
Ctrl/CmdZUndo (code, logic and display)
Ctrl/CmdShiftZRedo
CtrlYRedo (Windows/Linux)
GToggle display grid (when not typing in a field)
+ / =Zoom display in
- / _Zoom display out
0Fit display to window
Display editor
ClickSelect a component; drag to move it
Shift + DragBox-select and add to selection
Arrow keysNudge selected components by 1 px
Shift + Arrow keysNudge selected components by 10 px
Delete / BackspaceDelete selected components
EscCancel placement or clear selection
Pinch / Ctrl/Cmd + WheelZoom display around pointer
Alt + PressSecond touch input in Touch mode
Code editor
Ctrl/Cmd + EnterReload / run the current script
Ctrl/Cmd + .Apply the quick fix for the problem on this line
HoverAn underlined problem shows what is wrong and how to fix it
Ctrl/Cmd + FFind in script
Ctrl/Cmd + HFind and replace
F3 / Shift + F3Next / previous search result
EscClose find / replace
TabInsert indentation
EnterSmart indentation (when enabled in Settings)
( [ { ' "Auto-insert matching closing character (when enabled)
Ctrl/Cmd + + / =Increase code font size
Ctrl/Cmd + -Decrease code font size
Ctrl/Cmd + 0Reset code font size
Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + [Fold all code blocks
Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + ]Unfold all code blocks
Ctrl/Cmd + ClickGo to function definition (when enabled)
Click / Arrow keysMove caret; matching-name highlight follows caret when enabled
Logic editor
ClickSelect a component and open its properties
DragMove a component or pull a wire from a pin
Delete / BackspaceRemove selected component or wire
Double-clickOpen a Lua Script component in the code editor
Panels and dialogs
Drag dividerResize the workspace and dock panels
Arrow Up / Arrow DownAdjust the lower panel height when focus is outside text fields
EscClose menus, dialogs or the colour picker

Shortcuts can depend on the active panel and focused field. Ctrl is used on Windows/Linux; Cmd is used on macOS. Some editing assistance can be enabled or disabled in Settings.
